reason: While the code is functioning correctly and passes all verification checks, the simulation has notable model shortcomings—particularly the lack of spatial clustering, agent heterogeneity, and insufficient validation metrics—which prevents it from achieving high fidelity or alignment with real-world data. There are no blocking code issues, and significant model improvements are both feasible and clearly identified. With two iterations remaining, substantial gains in realism and evaluability can be achieved by prioritizing these enhancements in the next iteration.

specific_areas: Implement spatial structure (e.g., grid or network) to enable clustering and local interactions
Expand agent properties to capture heterogeneity (susceptibility, infectivity, position, etc.)
Enhance temporal dynamics (e.g., track time since infection for each agent, allow variable infectious period)
Add additional validation metrics and output (e.g., R_t, spatial statistics, infection chains)
Parameterize population size to match real-world entity count

data_analysis.adjustments: Incorporate more detailed analysis of spatial and temporal patterns in the real-world data for calibration and validation; ensure entity count and clustering are explicitly compared.

model_planning.adjustments: Prioritize adding spatial structure, heterogeneity in agents, and temporal detail to the model plan; define clear validation metrics for each.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement a spatial grid or network in the simulation; update the Person class with new attributes (position, susceptibility); refactor infection logic to use local interactions; parameterize population size; add logging for new metrics.

code_verification.adjustments: Update tests and smoke checks to cover new features (spatial logic, agent attributes, new outputs); ensure spatial and heterogeneous features are validated.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Run simulations with both the original and enhanced models for comparison; ensure the new metrics are being computed and recorded.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Evaluate spatial and temporal outputs against real-world data; assess if clustering and heterogeneity yield improved alignment; analyze new metrics (e.g., R_t).

feedback_generation.adjustments: Provide focused feedback on the impact of added spatial/heterogeneity/metrics features and their effect on realism and data alignment.
